title: Hoshino Ichika — An Awaited Message〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before the show
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tomorrow's finally the day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Our very first solo show...
As nervous as I am...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If it goes well, we'll get a chance to go pro together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's making me even more nervous...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just take...a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
I should change out my strings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There's no rust on them and it feels like a bit of a waste... But I also don't want them to snap on me during our show...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Where are the ones I just bought...?
I thought I put them away with the wire cutters... Oh, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Start by unwinding them one by one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? A message?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hey, I was trying to fall asleep just now but can't because I'm so nervous!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Sleep...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Isn't it a little early to go to bed? It's only eight.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho just wrote something...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Of course you are. It's only eight.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hey, no fair! Don't gang up on me like that!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Seriously? You didn't see this coming?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, these strings actually have a lot of dings and scratches on them. Changing them out was a good idea...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess we have been practicing a lot more than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Oh, Saki. She's sending us so many sad face stamps.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Saki, these notifications and those faces are getting really annoying.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Wahhh!
Ichi, Shiho's bullying me!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <To be fair, this stamp's face does look pretty obnoxious.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <How's that supposed to make me feel better? T_T>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami's writing something now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Saki, it's apparently not good to go to bed so early since your body isn't ready to fall asleep yet.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <So, it's probably best to try to go to bed at your usual time.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Going to bed too early could lead to waking up too early and feeling sleepier sooner than normal?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Yeah, you might not be able to stop yawning before we take the stage.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Oh... I don't want that to happen!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I just need to trim the strings and tune it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, where'd I put my tuner...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Can we talk for a bit since we're all online?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Only a little bit.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm okay with that.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we're having a group call now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Hehe. Good evening, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Good evening to you as well.
Honestly, Saki, you sound the furthest thing from sleepy right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Yeah, was this all just some sort of elaborate rouse?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <No, it wasn't! I tried to go to sleep because I finished doing all my homework and had nothing else to do...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hehe. You finished all your homework, Saki? Good for you.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<*Sob*
Hona, you're the only one who's ever nice to me!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <While we're on the subject, what were you guys doing just now?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I was practicing on my bass.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I was going over what we need to do when after we arrive at the live house tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <The manager and I need to go through a big checklist for our show.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Hona's here to save the day!
What about you, Ichi?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was changing out the strings on my guitar. It seemed like a bit of a waste at first, but they were more dinged up than I initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really?! Oh, since you've put on some new strings, I wanna hear you play something for us♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, but I haven't tuned it yet.
It might sound a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Then, can we listen while you tune it?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I hear you tuning your guitar in SEKAI from time to time, but I find it really soothing for some reason.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Yes, I think I know what you mean.
It's such an strange sensation...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll listen to it as background music while I clean my strings.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? I'm starting to get a little nervous now that I know you're all going to be listening...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <You are? What makes you more nervous? This or tomorrow's show?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... This maybe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really?! That means you're probably gonna play out of your mind tomorrow, Ichi!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <How does that work?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I doubt I'm going to play that well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I feel much better compared to just now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I'll put you on speaker and start tuning my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Okay♪ Then, I'll be thinking of some stuff to say when we talk to the crowd!>
